title: The Knocking Below
text: The miners have stopped work. Behind the deepest face of your mine something is knocking back, three and three, the way the miners knock to say they are alive.

options.label: Break through to whatever is knocking, in case it is a crew still living.

outcomes.text: Beyond the wall, a lost seam of iron, and the bones of an old crew who knocked until they could not.
Beyond the wall, a cave of black glass, singing faintly.
The wall comes down on the Scion who led the dig.

options.label: Knock back, three and three, and wait to learn what answers.

outcomes.text: The knocking stops. The seam beyond it gives freely for a while.
It knocks back, closer. Then it knocks under the Seat's cellar floor.

options.label: Collapse the gallery, and bury whatever knocks.

outcomes.text: The gallery comes down. The mine yields less this Year, and the miners swear they still hear it, fainter.
